parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a woman phoning a festival office to inquire about some festival activities.

First, you have some time to look at questions one to six.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.

Beechen Festival office.

Oh, hello. I want to check some details about the festival. I know tickets are running out fast, and I haven't got access to the Internet at present. My computer's down.

Okay. Well, the first activity is on June the nineteenth at seven PM, and it's a concert with local musicians performing.

Oh, lovely. Is it in the theater like last year?

Yes, that's right. And for the next activity on the twentieth, the time's changed.

Is that the tour?

Yes. Now, it does say on the tickets that it's a three-forty start, but that's an error. There wasn't time to update them, unfortunately, so it should say four thirty instead. The correct time is on the website, though.

Oh, right. Because one of my friends wants to go on that to see Beechen with an expert and find out about the town and its history. Does she need to get a ticket in advance?

No, just turn up at the station where the guide will be waiting. They'll start from there, and I think the plan is to stop for a break in the park, and there's no charge for the tour. And the tour will finish with a visit to the sixteenth-century mill where they used to make flour. It's recently been restored.

Fine.

And then on the twenty-first, there's an all-day event for children.

Oh, that could be good for my visitors. They're bringing theirs, you see.

Right. Well, the plan was to have a painting competition for the kids, but it's now going to be cooking instead. And there'll be prizes for all the different age groups.

Oh, great.

And it's in Beechen Community Center.

Oh, yes, I know where that is.

They don't need to bring any ingredients, but they'll need to have a plate to put whatever they've made on so they can display it and then take it home.

Sounds good. And are they going ahead with the fireworks in the evening, or is that canceled? There was an article in the paper after last year's display which suggested it might not be happening again.

That's right. No, that's still on. It's getting more popular each year, and having it in the town square was starting to be a bit difficult because of the numbers, which is why it's next to the river this time. It'll be easy for large numbers of people to get to.

Yes, of course. I'm sure there's lots to look forward to.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten on page two.

Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.

Okay. Now, I just want to check how it's going to impact on me as a local resident. I mean, some people last year thought it was too noisy at night.

Yes, I know. And that's why this year, evening events won't go on beyond eleven fifteen. I know previously some activities lasted until eleven forty-five, and the new time applies now to all the events every evening.

Okay.

And another change, perhaps you know about this already, is that because of high visitor numbers, parking in the town center isn't going to be allowed. It'll be outside town.

Oh, yes. To keep the streets clear, I suppose, for all the visitors. I, I did know, actually, and it's not really going to be a problem for me.

Right.

I mean, I, I can just walk into town from my home.

Okay. Well, anyway, if you want to check any more details about the festival once you're back online, you can look at www.events.com. And you'll be able to comment on what activities you enjoyed and what would really help the organizers would be if people could use the website to give feedback about what they enjoyed and that kind of thing. This will help them plan for next year.

That's probably a good idea. And with pricing, I know local residents...

That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

analyses.content: 录音中女士用提问的方式猜出音乐会和去年一样在theater（剧院）举行，男士随之给出了肯定的确认回答。
这个题的答案是提问方说出来的，如果你的预期只在回答方身上，就容易漏听关键信息。
Well, the first activity is on June the nineteenth at seven PM, and it's a concert with local musicians performing. Oh, lovely. Is it in the theater like last year? Yes, that's right.
录音中明确指出票上的时间印错了，正确的时间应该是four thirty（4:30）。
录音中先出现了干扰时间three forty（3:40），当你听到紧接着的“but that's an error”（但那是个错误）时，就要立刻把它排除掉。

Now, it does say on the tickets that it's a three forty start, but that's an error. There wasn't time to update them, unfortunately. So it should say four thirty instead. The correct time is on the website, though.
录音中明确提到，直接去station（车站）集合，导游会在那里等候并从那里出发。
录音中随后提到了park（公园），但那是行进中途休息的地方，你需要紧扣题干的“meet at”（集合）来锁定正确地点。
No, just turn up at the station where the guide will be waiting. They'll start from there, and I think the plan is to stop for a break in the park.
录音中明确表示，针对孩子们的比赛内容现在改成了cooking（烹饪）。
录音中先提到了原计划是painting（画画）比赛，但紧接着用“but”进行了转折否定，你需要捕捉到最终确认举办的活动。
Well, the plan was to have a painting competition for the kids, but it's now going to be cooking instead.
录音明确指出孩子们需要自带一个plate（盘子），用来盛放做好的食物。
录音中提到了ingredients（食材），但前面跟着否定词“don't need to bring”，你需要听准“需要带”的东西而不是“不需要带”的东西。
They don't need to bring any ingredients, but they'll need to have a plate to put whatever they've made on so they can display it and then take it home.
录音中解释了因为人数太多，所以这次的烟火表演改在了river（河）旁边。
录音中提到了town square（城市广场），但那是以前举办的地方，你需要抓住关键词“this time”（这次）来锁定最新的地点。
It's getting more popular each year, and having it in the town square was starting to be a bit difficult because of the numbers, which is why it's next to the river this time.

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到，今年的晚间活动不会超过eleven fifteen（11:15）。
录音中紧接着提到了eleven forty-five（11:45），但那是以前（previously）的时间，你要注意区分今年的新规定。

And that's why this year, evening events won't go on beyond eleven fifteen. I know previously some activities lasted until eleven forty-five, and the new time applies now to all the events every evening.
录音中指出，由于游客众多，今年市中心将不允许parking（停车）。
题目问的是市中心“won't be any”（不会有）什么，录音中的“isn't going to be allowed”恰好对应了这层意思，只要不忽略整体语义就能抓准答案。
And another change, perhaps you know about this already, is that because of high visitor numbers, parking in the town center isn't going to be allowed. It'll be outside town.
录音中非常直接地报出了网址是www.events.com，将events填入即可。
网址拼写题信息过得非常快，你需要精准捕捉拼写，并且千万注意events这里的复数“s”不能漏掉。
Well, anyway, if you want to check any more details about the festival, once you're back online, you can look at www.events.com.
录音中提到，如果人们能在网站上提供feedback（反馈），对组织者会非常有帮助。
题目填空前写的是“receive”（收到），而录音中说的是大家去“give”（给出）反馈，你要能听懂这种因为主语变化导致的动作方向转换。
And what would really help the organizers would be if people could use the website to give feedback about what they enjoyed and that kind of thing. This will help them plan for next year.
